description: We’re Team Predators from the Ajman Local Event. Our project is a game for the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge. We want young players to step into the role of an astronaut, make decisions during a space mission, and learn from the results.
summary:
Our team, The Sharks, developed a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, an interactive game that introduces young learners to how astronauts prepare for space missions. Players take on the role of astronaut trainees and work through challenges that encourage them to observe carefully, solve problems, and think through their decisions.

The game addresses the challenge by giving learners a chance to experience the idea of astronaut training through play. It helps them see that a space mission begins long before launch, with preparation, practice, and problem-solving. By making these ideas accessible to younger students, we hope to spark their curiosity about space exploration and build their confidence in tackling science and engineering challenges.
details: Shark Cadets is a game for the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge. Players step into the role of astronaut cadets, make decisions during training for a space mission, and learn from the results of those decisions. We designed the experience for young learners to practise decision-making and to understand how astronauts prepare for life and work in space. Our aim is to make human spaceflight approachable and fun, so students stay curious about space science and exploration.
